central_candidate.name: CONSUME_BOUND_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT
central_candidate.statement: For any state, artifact, identity, capability, causal receipt, authority decision, training split or provider result that can influence persistent state or an effect, recording provenance is insufficient: the exact consumer must verify that provenance and identity still bind the exact object/epoch/action being consumed, and mutation-capable consumption must be replay-safe/exactly-once.

converging_mechanism_classes: storage/boot pre-admission identity and import topology
capability executable artifact identity at probe and use
Needle provider output separated from admitted authority bindings
reward producer-owned terminal source plus exactly-once/rebuild semantics
heldout manifest identity plus independent audit validity

anti_echo.shared_ancestry_warning: Cross-branch convergence is not independent replication because many lanes share Frank/Clay/UnifiedDB/effect/re-entry ancestry.
anti_echo.promotion_rule: Promote only after branch-specific falsifiers plus an integrated consume-bound composition discriminator on accepted target.

authority_boundary: Research/test obligations only; no Frank self-Harness authority, effect authority or training authority granted.
